latitude.description:
Latitude of location. Accepts up to 5 decimal points of precision. 
      The valid range of latitude in degrees is -90 and +90

longitude.description:
Longitude of location. Accepts up to 5 decimal points of precision. 
      The valid range of longitude in degrees is -180 and +180

enterRadiusMeters.description:
Enter radius in meters. Radius for entering the geofence 
    (when driver arrives).

exitRadiusMeters.description:
Exit radius in meters. Radius for exiting the geofence 
    (when driver departs)

allOf.description: Geofencing definition. Only "circle" is supported for now.

get.description:
Below is a list of all the forms that Maven provides for Truckload experience. In general these can be customized by the fleet.

      - start trip
      - end trip
      - arrive stop/terminal
      - auto-arrive stop/terminal
      - depart stop/terminal
      - auto-depart stop/terminal
      - workflow (forms associated to specific stop/terminal)
        - ex: trailer info, delivery info
      - ad-hoc (forms not assigned to a particular stop, but accessible to drivers throughout their day)
        - ex: break-down form, time-off request    
    
    
    Retrieves form definitions from the Maven system.

200.description: A successful API response for fetching form definitions from the Maven system

404.description: When form definitions not found for company

500.description: Unknown error response from the customers service.

post.description:
The create trip API allows for the creation of a trip and associated stops
    in the Maven system.
    The apiKey header authenticates and authorizes the request to submit trip
    data for a specific company.

201.description: A successful API response for trip creation

put.description:
The update trip API allows for the updating of a trip 
    in the Maven system.
    The apiKey header authenticates and authorizes the request to submit trip
    data for a specific company.

200.description: A successful API response for trip update

patch.description:
The update trip API allows for the updating of a trip

    The apiKey header authenticates and authorizes the request to submit trip
    data for a specific company.

200.description: A successful API response for trip update

delete.description:
The delete trip API allows for the deletion of a trip 
    in the Maven system.
    The apiKey header authenticates and authorizes the request to submit trip
    data for a specific company.
